ammonia.reason: No ammonia measured; 60-d rennet cheese with modest deamination, no washed-rind Brevibacterium activity.

animal_barnyard.reason: No phenols/indole/p-cresol detected; faint animal note only from branched 2-methylpropanoic/3-methylbutanoic acids.

bitter.reason: Chymosin plus LAB proteinases produce hydrophobic peptides at pH ~5, partly masked by salt and FFAs.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium; low methyl ketones 2-heptanone 2.7-7.4 mg/kg and 2-nonanone <1 mg/kg from fatty-acid beta-oxidation.

browning.reason: Low residual lactose limits Maillard; moderate protein 38-41% TS plus fat gives light golden browning on heating.

buttery.reason: Citrate fermentation by Lactococcus/Leuconostoc starter yields diacetyl 1.5-8.6 mg/kg and acetoin 3.8-19.9 mg/kg.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Kid-goat pregastric lipase in rennet paste releases butanoic 33-173 mg/kg and hexanoic 16-40 mg/kg.

creaminess.reason: 55% fat-in-dry-matter (~33% fat) lubricates but low moisture and goat short-chain fat reduce melt-in-mouth.

crumbliness.reason: Low pH demineralization solubilizes colloidal calcium phosphate, giving short crumbly goat-curd fracture.

firmness.reason: Pressed 59-65% total solids, pH ~5, 2-mo drying to ~40% moisture gives dense semi-hard body.

floral_honey.reason: No phenylalanine catabolites phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol detected in 28-compound profile.

fruity.reason: Ethanol esterified with FFAs by LAB esterases to ethyl butanoate 0.4-3.8 mg/kg and ethyl hexanoate 0.2-2.8 mg/kg.

goaty.reason: Goat milk plus rennet-paste lipolysis gives 32 g/kg total FFA with 28% C4-C12 including hexanoic and branched acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Leucine Strecker degradation by LAB yields abundant 3-methylbutanal 8-12 mg/kg and 3-methylbutanoic acid.

melt.reason: Rennet gel retains meltability but pH <5.1 and ~2.8% salt limit casein hydration and flow when heated.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one detected; alcohol fraction only ethanol, propanol, pentanol, heptanol.

oil_off.reason: High 55% FDM with extensive lipolysis frees short-chain triglycerides, releasing moderate free oil on melting.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked curd, no phenols/guaiacol detected; paprika/gofio coating is not smoke-derived.

sour_vinegar.reason: Homofermentative lactic acid plus acetic 10-32 mg/kg from lactose/citrate gives pH ~4.9-5.0.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet curd set at 32C with no hot-water stretching, no aligned casein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: No S-volatiles among 28 headspace compounds; mild 72-76C 20s pasteurization, uncooked 32C curd.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted by starter; faint sweet from acetoin/diacetyl and glycerol, no residual sugar.

umami.reason: 60-d rennet/plasmin plus LAB peptidases release glutamate/small peptides, enhanced by ~2.8% NaCl.
